system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:48:44 UTC, the domain controller recorded a Kerberos service-ticket request for FILE-HD-01$ using svc-bkp, with the request originating from public IP 45.79.19.196.

The inventory identifies svc-bkp as a backup agent account on FILE-HD-01, and says there is no VPN and remote administration is only performed from WS-OHADDAD-01. The observed public-IP authentication is therefore inconsistent with the documented access pattern and warrants treating the activity as malicious unless validated.
At 13:46:06 UTC, FILE-HD-01 connected to DC-HD-01 over SMB; the associated log records an ANONYMOUS LOGON using NTLM.

At 13:29:25 UTC, a Veeam Backup Service process on FILE-HD-01 attempted explicit-credential use of svc-claimsync against FILE-HD-01, shortly before the scheduled password rotation. The record alone does not establish whether this was expected job behavior.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not directly identify the process, destination, or byte count for the alert’s reported large outbound transfer.

The provided proxy records show small CONNECT tunnels to Windows Update and Zscaler, not a documented large transfer; the records do not establish that proxy telemetry is complete for the alert period.
claims_not_established: That the public IP address belongs to an attacker rather than a legitimate, specifically authorized service.
That the svc-bkp ticket request caused the reported large outbound transfer, or that the transfer went to an unapproved destination.
Which files or data, if any, were transferred.
Whether the anonymous SMB session accessed a share or performed any consequential operation.
additional_evidence_needed: Correlate firewall, NetFlow, and complete proxy logs around 13:46 UTC to identify the transfer destination, duration, and byte count.
Collect FILE-HD-01 process/network telemetry and CobaltVault agent logs for the alert window to attribute the transfer and verify the expected backup destination.
Validate the source and purpose of 45.79.19.196 against approved service-provider infrastructure; review DC authentication records and svc-bkp account activity around 13:48:44 UTC.
Review FILE-HD-01 SMB audit/share-access logs for the anonymous session at 13:46:06 UTC.
